meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: Claude 会调用浏览器命令行工具,替你打开网址、点击元素、填写表单、截图、提取页面信息,并可通过编号引用页面元素一步步操作。
howto.when: 当你要浏览网页、填写表单、截图,或做测试/数据提取等网页自动化任务时触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com,把当前页面截图保存一下。
say.note: 会自动打开网址并生成截图文件。

say.text: 在 example.com 的登录框里输入账号,然后点击登录。
say.note: 会定位输入框填入内容并点击登录按钮。

howto.what_en: Claude can drive a command-line browser tool to open pages, click elements, fill forms, take screenshots, extract page info, and act on elements by numbered refs from accessibility snapshots.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to browse the web, fill forms, take screenshots, or run web automation tasks like testing or data extraction.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot of the page.
say_en.note: It will open the URL and save a screenshot file.

say_en.text: On example.com, enter the account in the login box and click Log in.
say_en.note: It will locate the input, fill it, and click the login button.

say_en.text: Compare the pages at https://v1.com and https://v2.com.
say_en.note: It will compare snapshots of the two pages and show differences.
